verdict.rationale: Helicone has its own data-access paths: a REST request-query endpoint (POST /v1/request/query), HQL, and a one-line PostHog export. A community user also confirms they can 'see each request and export them all' to build a fine-tuning dataset. Nothing documents bulk export to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS) or a data warehouse, so the story's core destination is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented bulk/scheduled export to blob storage, native data-warehouse connectors (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery), dataset-level export docs, independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale export.
